<!-- pr-reviewer: f4ac21ecd3f738699987875c7ea35f6139456705 -->
Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4162, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney/.claude-bob seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a safety-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code (the Mach4 `G82` / `G89` `P` word).

### What the PR does
- `assets/posts/mach4.cps:841` now calls `trimDec(secDwell, 3, true)`. A whole-second dwell posts with its decimal point (`P1.`, `P2.`). A fractional dwell does not change (`P0.25`).
- `crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs` pins 250 ms, 1000 ms and 2000 ms on `DRILL` and `SPOT` (`G82`) and on `BACKBORE` (`G89`).
- This meets the "Done means" of #4141: the test pins a 1 s and a 2 s dwell with a decimal point.

### Checks
- I read `trimDec` (`mach4.cps:92-100`). With `keepDot = true`, `1.000` gives `1.`, `0.250` gives `0.25` and `1.500` gives `1.5`. The change touches only the dwell word. The other `P` words (`G10 L2 P`) do not use this call.
- Goldens moved: none. No recorded Mach4 program (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc`, `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/mach4`, `examples/`) has a `G82` or `G89` line. The `example_catalog` suite is green.
- Laws: one commit, `fix(post): ...`, with `Fixes #4141` at the end of its body. The PR body has a `Changelog:` line. The PR changes no process file, no UI, no snapshot PNG and no dependency. It adds no test binary. The post-script file has no length limit.

### Results (built locally on a trial merge of the head with upstream/main)
- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 64 steps, 0 failed, 5.5 min. This includes `post suites: mach4_post`, `script_mach4`, `mach4_trunnion`, `mach4_feed_decimals`, `cycle_dwell`, `dwell_cycles_modal_p` and `app suites: conformance`, `mach4_builtin`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`, release): 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Pinning test: `mach4_supported_cycle_dwells_use_seconds_on_g82_and_g89_only`: pass (`mach4_post`: 6 passed).

Extra suites run: none apply. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no import code.

### Mutations (in the review worktree only, then restored)
1. `trimDec(secDwell, 3, false)` (the old line): the test is RED. `G82 dwell 1000ms must write P1.: G82 X0. Y0. Z-10. R2. P1 F120`.
2. `trimDec(secDwell * 1000, 0, false)` (milliseconds): the test is RED. `G82 dwell 250ms must write P0.25: ... P250 F120`.

After the file was restored, the test is green again.

### Optional, non-blocking
- Mach4 has a control setting that reads a dwell `P` as milliseconds. This review did not check, from a Mach4 manual, how that setting reads `P1.`. The issue accepts the decimal point as the fix. A follow-up can add a note to the program header that the dwell is in seconds (suggested `P7`).

@JSwetz: the review is clean. Please mark the PR ready (`gh pr ready 4162`), so that it can merge on this review.
